questions: When the board is fully visible, does it hold exactly three pens arranged in a single row?
Are all three pens aligned identically, all pointing the same way, including any pen near the left or right frame edge as it enters or exits?
Do all three pens share identical barrel and cap colors, with no mismatch?
Is every pen fully capped with no exposed writing tip, and are all three pens equal in length?
Does the board advance steadily from left to right at EVERY moment, never halting, freezing, or pausing even briefly (1-3 seconds) at any point in the video?
Do all pens stay fixed in their positions on the board, with no pen shifting, sliding, or moving on its own relative to the board mid-clip?

question_answers.evidence: When the board is fully in the frame (approx 00:08 to 00:20), there are exactly three pens arranged in a row.
All three pens are oriented with the black cap/end at the bottom and the translucent barrel pointing up. They are aligned identically.
All three pens appear to be the same model with black caps and grey/translucent barrels. No color mismatch is visible.
All pens appear capped (dark end down) and are of equal length. No bare tips are exposed.
The board moves from left to right initially, but then appears to stop or freeze in the center of the frame from approximately 00:12 to 00:20 before continuing to move right at the end of the clip.
The pens remain fixed in their positions on the board throughout the movement.

parsed.reason: The board exhibits a motion failure. It pauses or freezes in the middle of its travel (roughly seconds 12-20) instead of moving smoothly and continuously from left to right.

description: The board pauses mid-travel, then continues.
